cover: Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Governor Limit Architecture'. Deep dark navy background with neon Salesforce-blue grid lines. Subtitle 'Designing Salesforce systems that never hit limits'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'Bulk Data Shape with set-based SOQL icon', 'Transaction Boundaries with circuit breaker icon', 'Async Load Shedding with queue icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'LIMIT-PRONE DESIGN' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'LIMIT-SAFE DESIGN' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: for (Order__c o : Trigger.new) { insert new Task(WhatId = o.Id); }, right column green border '// GOOD' code: List<Task> tasks = OrderTaskFactory.build(Trigger.new); Database.insert(tasks, false, AccessLevel.USER_MODE);. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'one query per object', 'one DML per aggregate', 'async for fan-out'. Footer bar: 'Architecture beats heroic debugging'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, high contrast.
images: Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Bulkification Is Not Enough'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Bulkification Is Not Enough'. Subtitle 'Bound the transaction before optimizing the code'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'Fan-out Risk with branching icon', 'CPU Budget with stopwatch icon', 'Retry Safety with circular arrow icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'BAD: BULKIFIED BUT UNBOUNDED' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'GOOD: DURABLE REQUEST + ASYNC WORKER' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: List<Entitlement__c> e = EntitlementFactory.buildAll(Trigger.new); insert e; publishProvisioningEvents(e);, right column green border '// GOOD' code: List<Order_Processing_Request__c> r = RequestFactory.fromOrders(Trigger.new); Database.insert(r, false, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.enqueueJob(new OrderProcessingQueueable(requestIds));. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'trigger detects intent', 'request record stores state', 'worker controls fan-out'. Footer bar: 'Do not let one save become an enterprise batch job'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.

Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Query Shape Controls Governor Pressure'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Query Shape Controls Governor Pressure'. Subtitle 'The cheapest limit is the one you never spend'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'Selective Filters with funnel icon', 'Aggregate in SOQL with sigma icon', 'Small DTOs with package icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'BAD: ROW MATERIALIZATION' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'GOOD: AGGREGATE QUERY' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: List<Invoice__c> inv = [SELECT Id, Amount__c FROM Invoice__c WHERE Account__c IN :accountIds WITH USER_MODE]; for (Invoice__c i : inv) total += i.Amount__c;, right column green border '// GOOD' code: SELECT Account__c accountId, SUM(Amount__c) totalAmount FROM Invoice__c WHERE Account__c IN :accountIds GROUP BY Account__c WITH USER_MODE.
